doc:
### PROPOSAL-12 — Steampunk Brass - **slug**: `steampunk` - **Vibe**: Victorian industrial machinery — dark leather and charcoal with brass, copper, rivets, and gauge dials. - **Best for**: Automation cockpit and Playwright run logs — publishing pipelines as steam-driven machinery. Adjectives: mechanical, warm, hand-built. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#12100c` | Dark leather-charcoal canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#1c1914` | Panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#272219` | Raised panels, modals | | `--border-subtle` | `#332c20` | Fine seam lines | | `--border-default` | `#4d4230` | Standard brass borders | | `--border-focus` | `#d9a441` | Brass focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#f2e9d8` | Warm parchment headings | | `--text-secondary` | `#c9bda4` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#8a7f6b` | Captions, gauge labels | | `--color-action` | `#c9812e` | Copper primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#b06f24` | Action hover (deeper copper) | | `--color-earnings` | `#d9a441` | Brass-gold earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#c28c32` | Earnings hover (deeper brass) | | `--color-automation` | `#7fb0a8` | Tarnished-teal gauge glass accents | | `--color-alert` | `#e0a02f` | Amber warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#a4452c` | Rust-red failed states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(201, 129, 46, 0.18)` | Copper tint behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(217, 164, 65, 0.16)` | Brass tint behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(127, 176, 168, 0.14)` | Teal tint behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"IM Fell English", "Marcellus", serif` — engraved Victorian serif for headings and nameplates. Sans/body: `"Spectral", Georgia, serif` at 400-600. Mono: `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for gauge readouts, timestamps, and log lines. Small caps with `letter-spacing: 0.04em`; numerals `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Rounded mechanical parts — 6-10px on cards, 8px on buttons. Borders are 2px brass (`--border-default`) with an engraved inner hairline. Rivet dots (2-3px brass circles) sit at card corners. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Brass-bordered with warm dark fill; primary = copper gradient fill with dark ink text (`#1c1914`); hover = brass glow. Secondary = transparent with 2px brass border. Focus = brass double outline. Small rivets flank the label on primary buttons. - **Cards**: Leather-dark panels with a 2px brass frame, engraved nameplate header bar, and rivets at the corners. Optional gauge dial motif in the header for status. - **Badges/Status**: Octagonal or oval brass-bezel chips with a glowing dot; publishing = rotating gear + pulsing amber; published = brass; failed = rust red. - **Tables**: Parchment-tinted rows on charcoal with thin brass rules; header row engraved-plate style (small caps, lighter). Row hover = 1px brass left rule. - **Forms/Inputs**: Engraved-line fields (dark fill, 1px brass border); focus = brass underline. Helper text in small caps. - **Loading**: A rotating gear (8-tooth, CSS-stepped) or a needle gauge sweeping; determinate = a dial gauge filling clockwise. - **Signature detail**: Brass rivets + copper/brass borders + gear and gauge dial motifs — machinery you can almost hear. - **Motion & Animation**: Heavy and mechanical — 200-300ms with one small overshoot "clunk"; gears rotate slowly on hover; status toggles click. No springs, no glides. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
REVENUE / 30D $12,480
```
